userRequest: Approve manually and enter the date on the certificate even when automatic interpretation reports a different identity.

design.decision: Association-specific manual review with vaccination_administered_on, author, timestamp and version.
design.globalData: Horse identity, original certificate metadata/date and automatic validation history remain unchanged.
design.compliance: Only the approving association uses its explicit human decision and entered date. Validity duration, future-date checks, refusal and Coggins rules remain enforced.
design.preview: Rendering/signing failure does not prevent manual approval with the entered date; original file link remains available when signing succeeds.

verification.browser: FR/EN mobile/desktop, date-only approval, unreadable preview with missing date, refusal, no-file guard, saved decisions and errors.
verification.build: passed before final presentation adjustments; repeated in CI.
